title: Onboard Elysian-30B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard Elysian-30B v1.0 into the model registry with canonical metadata, performance profiles for supported hardware/sequence-lengths, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: Elysian-30B is a widely requested open model with strong accuracy/cost tradeoffs for our mid-range GPU tiers; making this available via the registry unlocks Dedicated and Hosted serving for customers and enables performance guidance from the console. This PR includes: 1) metadata: model manifest (architecture, tokenizer, default configs, checksum, license) and semantic tags for routing and fallback; 2) perf profiles: throughput/latency profiles for A100-40GB, A10G, T4 across common sequence-length buckets; 3) quantization recommendations and compatible artifact pointers; 4) changelog automation: a script to emit release-notes from model manifest diffs and perf-profile updates, plus CI job to publish to the registry docs; 5) docs: onboarding guide and examples. Checklist: [x] canonical metadata schema populated; [x] perf runs captured and validated; [x] changelog automation tested locally; [x] docs updated; [x] unit + integration tests added. Testing/validation: synthetic perf harness runs attached in artifacts; unit tests for manifest validation; end-to-end dry-run of changelog generator that mirrors production output. Linear/Jira refs: ENG-2371 tracked model onboarding tasks; PM-128 product acceptance criteria. Notes: perf numbers marked as median of 5 runs; we include both 8k and 2k sequence buckets per perf guidance; changelog generator produces a markdown-snippet that will be merged to docs site via the registry pipeline. For follow-ups: schedule long-tail stability runs (ENG-2410) and add weight-decay compatibility note in tokenizer docs.
